_comment: What the snapshots page reads at build time. The bucket cannot be listed publicly, so the candidate heights are listed here; a height whose manifest is not published yet is simply not shown. Layout and fields: ycash-infra bundles/state/FORMAT.md (ycash-state/2, kogany-state/1 and /2) on vaults/kogany-compat, and bundles/state/mainnet/README.md.

families.title: Pruned
families.desc: All the state a Kogany node needs to run, with raw transactions kept for the most recent 34,560 blocks (30 days). One-way: a pruned node can't return to archive mode.

families.title: Archive
families.desc: The full Kogany state, including every historic transaction. Restores into an archive or a pruned node.

families.title: ycashd
families.desc: A ycashd 6.22 datadir (blocks, chainstate, vaults), with the node's own statement of the state and its Sapling tree state.
